worldcombat.skill.simplebeam.summary: Fire a mysterious psychic wave that rewrites the target's Ability into Simple; the wave option also simplifies the Abilities of Pokemon in a ring around it.
worldcombat.skill.simplebeam.use.0: overwrite a foe's strong Ability with Simple
worldcombat.skill.simplebeam.use.1: shut down a fighter that runs on its own Ability
worldcombat.skill.simplebeam.use.2: sweep a whole ring of Abilities with the wave option
worldcombat.skill.simplebeam.description: Rewrite the target's Ability into Simple for %1$s.
Wave range %1$s blocks, wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s, following speed and size.
Wave radius %1$s blocks; the wave bursts at the target and washes over that area, wider on a wider body.
worldcombat.skill.simplebeam.wave.on: Psychic wave: bursts at the target and washes over a %1$s-block ring, at %2$s cooldown and a shorter rewrite for each.
worldcombat.skill.simplebeam.wave.off: Single beam: one target only, rewrite lasting %1$s, faster to cast.
worldcombat.skill.simplebeam.timing: Range %1$s blocks, wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s, %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
On = Psychic wave: the beam bursts at the target and simplifies rewrite-able Pokemon in the ring around it, but each lasts x0.6 and cooldown is +18; off = single beam: one target, duration x1.35, cooldown -8. Coverage trades against duration.
The companion only considers a beam on a threat within this distance; lower stays close, higher chases further.
When on, it will leave its post to fire the beam.
world_combat.move.simplebeam.text.spread: The wave sweeps past; %1$s targets had their Abilities simplified
world_combat.move.simplebeam.text.clear: The mental wave fades; its Ability returns
